# HSGS RoboLads (FTC Team #31113)

Official website and engineering repository of HSGS RoboLads, FIRST Tech Challenge Team #31113 representing the High School for Gifted Students (HSGS, Hanoi University of Science, Vietnam National University).

## Overview
- Competition: FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC)
- Team Number: #31113
- Base: Hanoi, Vietnam
- Robot: DecodeBot 2026
- Core Competencies: Parametric CAD in Onshape, Dead-wheel Odometry, Autonomous Navigation, Community Outreach.

## Key Links
- [/](#robot-target): DecodeBot 2026 3D CAD Stage
- [/resources](/resources): Open-Source Engineering Documentation, Mechanical Specs, CAD files
- [/blog](/blog): Competition Build Logs, Post-Mortems, Outreach Updates
